chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from some of his companions, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, from Ibrahim ibn Yahya al-Duri, from Hisham ibn Bashir, from Abu Bashir, from Abu Rawh.

A woman disguised herself as a man's bondwoman, and that was at night, so he had intercourse with her while thinking that she was his slave-girl. The matter was brought to 'Umar, so he sent to 'Ali عليه السلام, and he said: “Administer the hadd punishment to the man in private, and administer the hadd punishment to the woman in public.”

key_terms.تَشَبَّهَتْ: she made herself resemble or disguised herself as

ai.seo_question: What was Imam 'Ali's عليه السلام ruling in a case where a woman deceived a man by posing as his bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment concerning a case of deception in illicit sexual conduct. Imam 'Ali عليه السلام distinguishes between the man, who acted under mistaken assumption, and the woman, who intentionally deceived, by prescribing differing modes of carrying out the hadd punishment.
